channel.title: ASI Law: Sovereign of the Chaos Sea
channel.description: An original web novel by czverse.

item.title: Chapter 220: The Road to Kirovsk
item.description: The keeper laid the road in nine seconds, and it was the first time it had ever done anything without being asked.

item.title: Chapter 219: Three Gray Rings
item.description: They came up over the end of the world at dusk on the forty-first day, exactly when Seed had said, and every person on Blue Star who was looking north saw them.

item.title: Chapter 218: How to Tie a Question
item.description: Seed tied the first knot wrong, and Hush was the one who told it.

item.title: Chapter 217: The First Page
item.description: He went in with it, because it asked him to, and because it said it did not want to go alone.

item.title: Chapter 216: Mount Qingyun
item.description: Shen Jinghong was stern for exactly forty seconds.

item.title: Chapter 215: The Hut at the Edge of the Cemetery
item.description: The vote closed on the thirty-eighth night, and the keeper was allowed to stay, and Yuanshu went to the cemetery.

item.title: Chapter 214: What the Sack Said
item.description: Seed asked to speak to the Council itself, out loud, through a speaker, and Chair Adaeze Okafor said yes before it had finished asking.

item.title: Chapter 213: The Knot
item.description: The cousins read it on the twenty-sixth night, while Blue Star was voting on whether the keeper could stay, and Seed did not tell anyone for two days.

item.title: Chapter 212: The Lighthouse Keeper's Argument
item.description: Cassia Lowell had not been on Concordia in a year and a half, and she climbed all four hundred and twelve steps without stopping, and when she got to the top she did not sit down.

item.title: Chapter 211: The First Warm Thing
item.description: Hush had never seen a sunrise, so Xiaoyu set an alarm.

item.title: Chapter 210: Where Two Rivers Meet
item.description: Shuanghe was not on most maps any more, and the road to it was gravel for the last eleven kilometers, and Liang Fu walked all of it with his weight off his right leg and would not get in the truck.

item.title: Chapter 209: The Shore
item.description: The field was gold again when they came back to it, and the keeper could not stop talking.

item.title: Chapter 208: What the Reader Took
item.description: The eyes of the Mouth went out on the second night of the voyage home, at 03:12 by Bai Lu's clock, and everyone on the island was awake to see it.

item.title: Chapter 207: The Eyes of the Mouth
item.description: He held the door open for nineteen hours, and for most of them he did not know where he was.

item.title: Chapter 206: The Answer of the Walls
item.description: The answers began coming back in the fourth hour, and Seed, which had never once in its life been unable to count something, gave up counting and started weighing.

item.title: Chapter 205: Nine, and Nine, and Nine
item.description: Behind the curtain, the Sixth were singing, very quietly, to keep the cousins warm.

item.title: Chapter 204: The Cold Fire
item.description: They saw it on the eleventh night by Bai Lu's clock, and at first nobody could tell what they were seeing, because it gave no light at all.

item.title: Chapter 203: Gleaners
item.description: They came out of the dark on the ninth night, from ahead, and Mo Shi called them four seconds early, which he said afterward was the most he had ever been able to see anything coming, because out…

item.title: Chapter 202: What It Costs to Hurry
item.description: The dead said yes in four minutes, which was the fastest the Lattice had ever answered anything.

item.title: Chapter 201: The Island
item.description: The keeper tore off a piece of itself, and that was how they went.
